name: trade-window-isolated-v1
hypothesis: Trade credit may be sensitive to the allowed response time; compare plausible whole-second thresholds while retaining exact killer-based refrag semantics.
source: Ignored cached normalized Match JSON at data/research/derived; no raw replay parsing or public actor input. Per-round calculate_match is the source of death/kill trade credit.
control: At 8 seconds, every retained round trade value must reproduce player_maps.jsonl. Reuse stored baseline model and CV record; no identical refit.
isolation: Only replace (deaths_traded - kills_traded)/rounds. KOST and every other player feature stay at the cached 8-second baseline values, even though KOST would mechanically change with a production window setting. Report this as a limitation; evaluate consistency separately before any runtime change.
model: Original raw eight available families, objectives omitted; standardized ridge alpha=1, intercept unpenalized. Opening differential and kills beyond first retained.
split: Seven pre-August events, 299 clean rows, leave-one-event-out; full fit against 32 August EWC development rows. Both September events excluded; NA final 60 sealed.
decision: Inspect per-fold and August accuracy, trade counts, coefficient drift and threshold sensitivity. A tiny pooled MAE difference alone does not select a new window.
